Nora (CS): Heads-up: account 'CedarClinic' shows a sudden 52% decline in inference calls from their triage team starting 2026-03-10. Billing notes flagged a new vendor evaluation.
Diego (AM): timeline on when new vendor was introduced? any exec change?
Nora (CS): procurement copied in new contact, Marco, on 2026-03-11. Their health data team seats fell from ~120 active to ~58.
Sam (Solutions): did we get any error spikes or auth failures? I scanned logs, nothing obvious. Could be a deliberate freeze for an internal PoC.
Ava (RevOps): Marco requested a side-by-side cost/throughput doc last week and asked for raw p50/p95 latency numbers by route.
Diego (AM): likely competitive evaluation + stakeholder switch. Nora, can you ask Marco for the evaluation criteria and any sample payloads?
Nora (CS): just messaged Marco asking for sample payloads and deadline. He replied: "We need a written comparison by Tue and a short demo next Wed."
Sam (Solutions): I can assemble a 1-page perf snapshot: p50/p95 by model, batching suggestions, and estimated 1k-token cost. Need sample payloads to reproduce.
Ava (RevOps): I'll prep a compact pricing delta spreadsheet and include optional trial terms (7-day Dedicated sandbox).
Diego (AM): keep offer contingent on sample payloads and a 30-min walkthrough with their infra lead. Nora, request the infra attendee on the invite.
Nora (CS): requested infra contact and asked timing.
notify-bot: Reminder: perf-batch-run scheduled 2026-03-16 04:00 UTC (job 9c2d1).
Sam (Solutions): I'll include quant vs float comparisons and KV cache warmup impact in the packet.
Diego (AM): recap actions: Nora - collect payloads + confirm attendees; Sam - perf packet and run sims; Ava - cost delta + trial terms; I'll lead the demo negotiation.
Nora (CS): update 2026-03-13 11:04: Marco shared a 10-sample payload set and asked for results by EOD Mon. Scheduling demo for 2026-03-17 10:00 ET.
Ava (RevOps): sending draft cost sheet now.
Sam (Solutions): running local sims now, will post numbers and a short README in this thread.
Diego (AM): if we miss EOD Mon, escalate to Marco's procurement manager.
Nora (CS): got it. attaching short note to the account timeline.
Diego (AM): thanks team. Post-demo we'll capture commitment signals and propose a phased concession (temp discount + SLA) if needed.
Nora (CS): will close loop after the demo. :thumbsup:
